# MIGA

MIGA is a local dessert and gifting brand from La Virginia, Risaralda, Colombia.

## What MIGA offers
- Artisan cookies made to order, including classic, chocolate, red velvet and filled varieties.
- Pavés with creamy layers for treats, sharing, gifts and special occasions.
- Personalized candles with custom shapes, colors, names/messages, labels, illustrations and gift sets.

## Brand idea
MIGA creates small, sweet moments that feel personal and memorable. The brand is warm, playful, creative and aspirational, with Spanish as the primary language and occasional Spanglish.

## Ordering
All MIGA products are made to order. Customers should reserve at least 5 days in advance.
WhatsApp: +57 313 620 5519

## Location
La Virginia, Risaralda, Colombia. Local delivery/coordination is confirmed through WhatsApp.
